name: Allison Miller
source:
Jake's ex-wife. She's smart, accomplished, a good mother and PISSED at Jake. A little over two years ago, Jake cheated on her with a co worker, and she has not let him forget it for a second. She thinks Jake was the love of her life, and the betrayal has cut her deep.
She realises that their daughter needs him around, and begrudgingly accepts the co-parenting routine they've fallen into. Will she ever forgive Jake, or is she just biding her time until she can remove him from their daughter's life completely?

[From [url=https://raceoflifegame.com]Official Site[/url]]
